Class WorldBuffer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.dod.WorldBuffer
public class WorldBuffer extends Object
High-performance Data-Oriented Storage for world hexagonal grid. Uses flat primitive arrays (AOSOA pattern) for GPU compatibility.

    Description
    float
    computeCellPowerWattsPerCapita(int index)
    Calculates total somatic and exosomatic mechanical and thermal power flux per individual in Watts, calibrated to Vaclav Smil (2017) Energy and Civilization: A History: $$P_{\text{watts/cap}} = B_{\text{basal}} + P_{\text{somatic}} + P_{\text{hearth}} + P_{\text{draft}}(k_{\text{pc}}) + P_{\text{mill}}(k_{\text{pc}}) + P_{\text{steam}}(k_{\text{pc}}) + P_{\text{grid}}(k_{\text{pc}})$$
    float
    computeEmergentTechnologyDiagnostic(int index)
    Computes the strictly a posteriori Garrett-Lotka emergent exergy-capital diagnostic index for a cell buffer index: $$T_{\text{emergent}} = 0.50 + 1.45 \log_{10}(\mathcal{M}) + 0.58 \log_{10}\!\left(1 + \frac{k_{\text{active}}}{k_0}\right)$$
    float
    computeEmergentTechnologyDiagnostic(Integer index)
    Computes the strictly a posteriori Garrett-Lotka emergent exergy-capital diagnostic index for a nullable boxed cell buffer index.

    • computeCellPowerWattsPerCapita

      public float computeCellPowerWattsPerCapita(int index)
      Calculates total somatic and exosomatic mechanical and thermal power flux per individual in Watts, calibrated to Vaclav Smil (2017) Energy and Civilization: A History: $$P_{\text{watts/cap}} = B_{\text{basal}} + P_{\text{somatic}} + P_{\text{hearth}} + P_{\text{draft}}(k_{\text{pc}}) + P_{\text{mill}}(k_{\text{pc}}) + P_{\text{steam}}(k_{\text{pc}}) + P_{\text{grid}}(k_{\text{pc}})$$
      Parameters:
      index - cell buffer index
      Returns:
      total continuous power dissipated per capita in Watts (\(\text{W}\))

    • computeEmergentTechnologyDiagnostic

      public float computeEmergentTechnologyDiagnostic(int index)
      Computes the strictly a posteriori Garrett-Lotka emergent exergy-capital diagnostic index for a cell buffer index: $$T_{\text{emergent}} = 0.50 + 1.45 \log_{10}(\mathcal{M}) + 0.58 \log_{10}\!\left(1 + \frac{k_{\text{active}}}{k_0}\right)$$
      Parameters:
      index - primitive cell buffer index
      Returns:
      dimensionless emergent technology diagnostic in \([0.0, 10.0]\)

    • computeEmergentTechnologyDiagnostic

      public float computeEmergentTechnologyDiagnostic(Integer index)
      Computes the strictly a posteriori Garrett-Lotka emergent exergy-capital diagnostic index for a nullable boxed cell buffer index.
      Parameters:
      index - boxed cell buffer index
      Returns:
      dimensionless emergent technology diagnostic in \([0.0, 10.0]\) (0.0f if null)
